summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch reported that authorities stopped a planned sparring exhibition between Tom Allen and Jimmy Walsh at the Comique under a new state law, so Allen appeared in his champion's belt and sang three or four songs instead.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'The Dispatch: St. Louis, Friday Evening, January 22, 1875'.

facts.fact: A sparring exhibition between Allen and Jimmy Walsh of London at the Comique, St. Louis, was stopped by authorities under a new Missouri statute prohibiting public sparring exhibitions
Allen appeared on stage at the Comique wearing his champion's belt and, at the audience's demand, sang three or four songs
